## Bridge Release

This compatibility bridge exists so launchers older than `2.5.0` can still auto-update.

- Includes `BnlCommunityFixes.exe`
- Includes `BnlUpdater.exe` for older launchers that still require `updater_exe` in the manifest
- Contains the new internal update-helper flow and embedded replay analyzer from the current launcher codebase

After users move onto this bridge release, they can later move forward to the single-exe release line.
